newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices ease on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices ease on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Thursday eased to 1,138/1,139 rupees per quintal from 1,145 rupees on the back of fresh speculative selling, dealers said.
Sluggish overseas demand and higher supplies prompted fresh bear selling while bull buying remained at a low ebb.
Daily arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained higher at 24,000/25,000 bags (75 kg each).
"Reports of bright crop prospects in Brazil and China as well as subdued trend in the world market also dragged down local prices," said Dilip Thakkar, a leading operator.
In Rotterdam castoroil spot prices slid by 10 dollars to 810 dollars per tonne.

Groundnut oil moved up by 2/3 rupees at 362/363 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals from the producing centres as crushing operations remained slow in the producing centres due to frequent power cuts. Imported palm-oil also moved up by 1/2 rupees at 277 rupees per 10 kg on reports of a recovery in the world market.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose to 563 rupees per 15 kg from 558/560 rupees.
